frame: Rater frame: precision first. Omit a guarantee unless the packet names a deployed artifact and a locator. Score the protocol as an element of the agentic commerce stack, not as a standalone product. Kleros is scored as a candidate L8 for agent-speed commerce, not as a general-purpose court.

C.promise: Scoped authority via signed intent/cart mandates
C.evidence: Intent and Cart Mandates signed as verifiable credentials in GitHub spec
C.failure: Revocation not consistently propagated into settlement (ledger L4)
C.metric: Mandate signature verification; revocation latency unmeasured

I.promise: Guarantees propagate across A2A/MCP and Web2/Web3 rails
I.evidence: A2A x402 extension with Coinbase/EF/MetaMask; UCP spec binds AP2
I.failure: Revocation not propagated into settlement, so cross-layer guarantee incomplete
I.metric: Number of specified bindings (UCP, x402, A2A, MCP)

A.evidence: Chain of evidence intent->cart->payment method as non-repudiable audit trail
A.failure: No economic finality or recoverability artifact; compliance absent
A.metric: Count=4 of seven properties (auth, exec, price, audit)

EM.promise: Payment-agnostic rail supports stablecoin access without banks
EM.evidence: Supports cards, stablecoins, real-time bank transfers (payment-agnostic)
EM.failure: Still requires a payment rail; no legal enforcement or dispute forum
EM.metric: Number of supported rails incl. stablecoins; reliance on court=0

S.promise: Public spec with broad industry collaboration
S.evidence: Public GitHub spec, reference implementations, 60+ named collaborators
S.failure: No versioned spec or named governance; implementer independence unverified

C.promise: Authorization, settlement evidence, replay resistance for HTTP payment.
C.evidence: HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE; facilitator verifies/settles; EVM/Solana/Algorand SDKs.
C.failure: Payment finality not bound to delivery; T3 open.
C.metric: Project-site tx volume (75.41M/30d), not independently audited.

I.promise: Bindings across HTTP Web2 and multiple Web3 blockchains.
I.evidence: Blockchain-agnostic SDKs; CAIP-2; A2A x402 extension; ERC-8004 proofOfPayment.
I.failure: Facilitator semi-trusted; no end-to-end delivery verification.
I.metric: Supported chain/SDK count; facilitator verification observable.

A.evidence: Auth via signature; finality on-chain; pricing exact/upto; audit via optional receipts; exec lacking delivery.
A.failure: Compliance and recoverability absent in base protocol.

EM.promise: Usable with weak banks, cards, ID, courts.
EM.failure: Fiat on/off-ramp and legal enforcement remain fallback institutions.
EM.metric: Unmeasured dependence on stablecoin and facilitator.

S.evidence: IETF draft; x402 Foundation; multiple independent SDKs.
S.failure: Receipt/compliance drafts not finalized; versioning not explicit.
S.metric: Independent SDK count and IETF draft status.

C.promise: Portable lifecycle state for orders, fulfillment, refunds.
C.evidence: Order object, fulfillment events, refund adjustments in public spec.
C.failure: Post-purchase state and refund portability remain merchant-specific.
C.metric: Standard event adoption across merchants for same order.

I.promise: Order state propagates across REST, MCP, A2A, AP2.
I.evidence: Specified transports and built-in AP2/A2A/MCP support with .well-known/ucp profile.
I.failure: Settlement finality stays in PSP/card/bank; portability depends on merchant webhooks.
I.metric: Bindings that carry one order through payment and fulfillment.

A.promise: Auditability and recoverability artifacts; partial auth/exec.
A.evidence: Order/fulfillment events; refund adjustments; OAuth identity linking.
A.failure: Economic finality and compliance continuity unaddressed.
A.metric: 4 of 7 properties addressed with observable artifacts.

EM.promise: Addresses commerce state without relying on courts.
EM.evidence: Payments still via MoR, PSP, card/bank rails; continue_url fallback.
EM.failure: Requires banking, card, and merchant platform support.
EM.metric: Institutional dependencies for a completed checkout.

S.promise: Public versioned spec with governance and adoption.
S.failure: No independent implementation count; vertical specs incomplete.
S.metric: Independent implementers and vertical spec coverage.

C.promise: Portable identity and behavioral trust to reduce adverse selection
C.evidence: EIP-8004 defines identity/reputation/validation registries with feedback hooks
C.failure: Draft only, no mainnet singleton; Sybil inflation and fragmented reputation open
C.metric: No deployed metric; response 0-100 only in spec

I.promise: Interoperable identity via A2A/MCP/ENS/DID endpoints and optional x402 proof
I.evidence: Registration file lists A2A/MCP/ENS/DID/wallet; proofOfPayment optional
I.failure: Bindings optional and one-sided; per-registry reputation not cross-chain
I.metric: No cross-chain consistency metric specified (CS1 absent)

A.promise: Assurance via identity, reputation, validation registries
A.evidence: No deployed artifact in packet; registries are deployable singletons only
A.failure: Cannot verify any property without deployment; capability claims not guaranteed
A.metric: No property count substantiated; response 0-100 only

EM.promise: Trust layer usable without banks/courts via on-chain reputation
EM.evidence: No deployed instance; design reduces dependence on formal ID/platform trust
EM.failure: Still needs blockchain access and validation fallback; no enforcement

S.promise: Public stable standard for agent identity and reputation
S.evidence: EIP-8004 draft with authors from MetaMask, EF, Google, Coinbase
S.failure: Draft, no independent implementations or final governance
S.metric: EIP number and magicians thread exist; no adoption count

C.evidence: Capability discovery in intro docs; clients/servers.
C.failure: Advertised capability not bound to demonstrated performance.

I.promise: Standard tool-interop layer usable across agents.
I.evidence: Cited by UCP as transport; A2A/AG-UI map MCP.

A.failure: No mandate scope enforcement; no payment/dispute.

C.promise: Discovery via Agent Card capability advertisement
C.evidence: Agent Card JSON in official spec
C.failure: No binding of advertised capability to demonstrated performance

I.evidence: Agent Card URL, SDKs, MCP/AP2/UCP integrations
I.failure: No native AP2 mandate or Web3 settlement binding

A.failure: No consent, finality, pricing, compliance, recovery

EM.failure: Still needs auth/ID and loss remedy fallback

C.promise: Stream agent state and UI intents; reveal agent reasoning to user.
C.evidence: Event protocol for streaming chat, thinking steps, interrupts.
C.failure: Interface transparency cannot hide weaker seams; no remedy.
C.metric: Presence of thinking-step visualization and approve/edit events.

I.promise: Interoperates with MCP and A2A as agent-user layer.
I.evidence: Framework integrations and SDKs; no cross-layer binding.
I.failure: No propagation across layer seams or Web2-Web3 boundary.
I.metric: None; no binding artifact in docs.

A.promise: HITL interrupts for approval, edit, retry.
A.failure: No mandate, settlement, or audit objects.

EM.promise: Works without banking or legal ID dependencies.
EM.evidence: UI event protocol; no institutional integration required.
EM.failure: Needs fallback for enforcement; no dispute objects.

S.promise: Open protocol with public docs and GitHub.
S.evidence: Official docs, GitHub repo, SDKs in multiple languages.
S.failure: No versioned spec or named governance identified.

C.evidence: Kleros Court and Escrow live since 2019
C.metric: No measured resolution time in packet

I.failure: Not wired into AP2/x402/UCP as default L8

A.promise: Assurance via on-chain evidence and arbitration

EM.promise: Works without courts, banks, formal ID
EM.evidence: Court, Escrow, Proof of Humanity products
